findings.summary: The in-container entrypoint imports /sandbox/app/pipeline/reviewer-container.js. The container mounts only the compiled dist directory, with no node_modules. That module chain reaches reviewer-runner.js, which has the value import of CLAUDE_SONNET_MODEL_ID from @ai-sdlc/reference. A bare specifier cannot be resolved in node:22-slim without node_modules, so every in-container run exits with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before writing verdicts.json and fails closed. Bundle the entrypoint into a self-contained file, or mount the needed node_modules read-only.

findings.summary: mkdirSync(outDir, { mode: 0o777 }) is masked by the process umask, so the directory ends up 0755 and owned by the host user. The container runs as 65534:65534 and cannot write verdicts.json (EACCES), so every run fails closed. Call chmodSync(outDir, 0o777) after mkdirSync.

findings.summary: The seccomp profile is passed inline (seccomp=JSON). Docker's --security-opt seccomp= expects a file path; sandbox-runner.ts documents this and the exit code 125 that follows. The reviewer container never starts, so the path always fails closed. Write the profile to a 0600 file in the mkdtemp scratch dir and pass its path.

findings.summary: The relay image alpine/socat:latest is a third-party image pulled by a mutable tag, running on the default bridge with internet access and carrying INFERENCE_PROXY_SESSION. A compromised tag could use the session token to send requests through the key-injecting proxy. Pin the relay image (and preferably the reviewer image) by sha256 digest.
